name: Resto Pro
tagline: Coming Soon — Restaurant Cash, Expenses & Staff, All in One Place
description: Resto Pro is a native Android ERP for small restaurants, food stalls, and hotels by MTP Code / Manoranjan — a full back-office clone of a real, live production restaurant management system, rebuilt from the ground up with a cloud-synced, multi-tenant account model. Every restaurant gets its own secure account (email + password, restaurant name and owner name captured at signup) with its data stored in the cloud (Supabase/Postgres) and protected by row-level security, so it's never tied to a single phone — sign in from a new device any time and pick up exactly where you left off. Daily cash and UPI collection, expense tracking with vendor credit (udhaar) management including partial payments, a Staff Hub with attendance and payroll, a unified Master Ledger, and Analytics/Reports with printable PDFs and CSV export, all wrapped in a colorful, animated Material 3 interface with light/dark theme and an App PIN lock. Package ID: in.mtpcode.restopro. Support: admin@mtpcode.com.
features: Real multi-tenant accounts — sign up with your restaurant name and owner name, data follows you to any device instead of being trapped on one phone
A 4-page onboarding carousel introduces the app's core modules before sign-up/log-in
Daily Cash Collection: log cash + UPI income in seconds, with a running total and recent-entries feed
Expense tracking with vendor/category management, PAID vs PENDING (udhaar) status, and category filters
Vendor Credit Manager: see every supplier's outstanding balance and settle it — full or partial payment, split cleanly between what's paid and what's still owed
Staff Hub: employee directory, a tap-to-cycle attendance calendar (Present/Half-day/Absent), advances and payouts, and automatic monthly-earned calculation from attendance
Master Ledger: every cash movement across the app — collections, expenses, vendor payments, staff payouts — in one unified, filterable feed, exportable to CSV

Analytics dashboard: annual revenue/expense/profit summary, a monthly performance bar chart, and an expense-distribution donut chart, all hand-rolled Canvas charts with no third-party charting library
Reports: quick This-Month/This-Year ranges or a fully custom date range, with a multi-page, letterhead-branded PDF export
Cloud Backup & Restore: export every table to one JSON file, or restore it back in — a safety net beyond the automatic cloud sync
App PIN lock with a salted-hash keypad gate and an escalating lockout after repeated wrong attempts
Light, dark, and system theme, with animated pulsing icon badges and count-up currency numbers throughout
Built on Supabase (Postgres + Auth) with row-level security on every table, so one account's data is never visible to another's — verified with real instrumented tests, not just manual clicks

notes: Public product page — app itself is feature-complete in development (cash collection, expenses/vendor udhaar with partial payments, Staff Hub, Master Ledger, Analytics, Reports, Backup) and pending Play Store submission
Real signup/login with per-restaurant cloud accounts replacing the earlier anonymous-only model
4-page onboarding carousel, App PIN lock with brute-force lockout, light/dark theme
